evals.prompt: Give me a capture run sheet for the original STATE_WAITING screen under Wine and the Rust waiting screen.
evals.expected_output: A reproducible contained capture plan with reference identity, native geometry, scenario controls, sync, and metadata.
expectations: Uses an isolated Wine prefix, display, and scratch game copy
Preserves native 800x600 reference frames and raw captures
Defines equivalent room scenario, input trace, and sync event
Keeps proprietary captures outside Git and records tool versions

evals.prompt: I need reference audio from the Wine Xvfb rig, but the game must not play through my speakers.
evals.expected_output: An audio-capture procedure using a dedicated virtual or null sink monitor with explicit signal validation.
expectations: Routes game audio away from the physical speakers
Explains that a completed ffmpeg command does not prove non-silent capture
Records sink or monitor, sample rate, channels, and resampling
Separates audio offset or drift evidence from loudness measurement
